name: ActivityNet-QA
intro: ActivityNet-QA 是面向长视频时空推理的全人工标注视频问答基准。它从 ActivityNet 采样 5,800 个复杂网络视频，每个视频众包编写 10 对问答，共 58,000 对；问题与答案由不同标注者处理，并通过不可答题返工、随机多人多数投票和四引擎翻译一致性检查保证质量。数据提供中英对齐版本。
build_method: ActivityNet分层采样, 众包中文问答与双重检查, 四引擎CIDEr共识门控, 百度或人工翻译
eval_feature: 视频问答, 长视频理解, 时空推理
build_method_en: Stratified ActivityNet sampling, crowdsourced Chinese QA with double checking, four-engine CIDEr consensus, then Baidu or human translation
eval_feature_en: Video QA, long-video understanding, spatio-temporal reasoning
intro_en: ActivityNet-QA is a fully human-annotated benchmark for spatio-temporal reasoning over long videos. It samples 5,800 complex web videos from ActivityNet and crowdsources exactly ten QA pairs per video, yielding 58,000 pairs. Separate question and answer annotators, regeneration of unanswerable items, random multi-annotator majority votes, and four-engine translation agreement checks provide quality control. Chinese and English versions are aligned.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:1906.02467v1 Dataset Construction and Evaluation Criteria sections plus official MILVLG/activitynet-qa snapshot 2cf80aeb4e45955e53404e1716d3b9c0b1cbd72f. Each video receives ten Chinese QA pairs covering motion, spatial, and temporal questions while the remaining questions are unrestricted; a second worker double-checks answerability. Four translations enter a CIDEr-threshold gate: high-consensus items keep the Baidu translation and low-consensus items receive human translation. The release records 32,000/18,000/8,000 QA pairs over 3,200/1,800/800 train/validation/test videos. Exact match is reported overall and by question type, whereas WUPS is an overall metric.
